feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Daniela Brozzoni has expressed willingness to serve as a BIP editor, emphasizing her qualifications and ongoing commitment to the Bitcoin development community. She is the author of BIP 394, which introduced the rawtr() descriptor and was merged earlier in the month. Additionally, she has contributed fixes to BIP 360, further demonstrating her involvement in the evolution of key Bitcoin Improvement Proposals.
Currently pursuing a master's degree focused on blockchain technology, Daniela dedicates much of her spare time to reviewing pull requests for Bitcoin Core. Her review activity can be verified through her contributions listed on [GitHub](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls?q=is%3Apr+reviewed-by%3Ajeanpablojp). She is able to commit 10-15 hours each week for at least the duration of her graduate program, which spans the next 18 months with a possibility of extending her participation beyond that period.
Daniela intends to begin her editorial responsibilities by focusing on new BIPs that are still pending a comprehensive review. She expresses a desire to learn from the current editors and to follow their guidance throughout her tenure. She also recognizes and appreciates the efforts made by Murch and other BIP editors in advancing the project.
